text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inari One and I decide she should race in the autumn Tenno Sho to gain more experience in big races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The best runners of this generation are going to be there, including the Beast Oguri Cap, and White Lightning Tamamo Cross.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Undeterred by the sheer presence those two have, Inari One readies herself and dives straight into their party, and the race finally begins!
